name: Jiangxi Fushine Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangxi Fushine Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of APIs and pharmaceutical intermediates in China and internationally. It offers ß-lactamase inhibitors, carbapenem antibiotics, and antiviral drug intermediates; argatroban injection for the treatment of acute ischemic stroke; and doxycycline hydrochloride dispersible tablets to treat rickettsial diseases, mycoplasmal and chlamydial infections, relapsing fever, brucellosis, cholera, tularemia, plague, and chancroid. The company also provides tazobactam, piperacillin, sultamicillin, sultamicillin tosylate, tazobactam sodium, sulbactam sodium, sulbactam pivoxil,…
